themes.name: Broker’s Manifesto
themes.concept: An anti-corporate operating manual: neo-brutalist publishing meets technical systems diagrams and counterculture editorial collage.

typography.display: Oversized heavy grotesk or condensed sans; Archivo Black direction
typography.accent: DM Mono or compact uppercase technical labels
typography.treatment: Tight headline leading, selective lime highlight bars, sober body copy.

principles: Split hero with independent artwork
Hard rules and offset shadows
Asymmetric editorial desk
Four-stage roadmap
Utility bento
Interactive calculators
Partner index
Resource downloads
Final conversion block
layout.density: High-impact focal sections with calm reading areas.

themes.imagery: Monochrome architectural photography, torn paper, classical sculpture cutouts, blueprint grids and selective acid-lime graphic interventions.
themes.motion: Sharp reveals and brief tactile shifts; static reduced-motion fallback.
guardrails: Avoid generic fintech stock imagery
Keep public and internal data separate
Do not confuse artwork with functional UI
Keep text and controls accessible
Use lime selectively

themes.name: Violet Ledger
themes.concept: A clean light-mode fintech SaaS system using confident violet accents and approachable financial dashboard fragments as its primary product proof.

typography.display: Contemporary heavy sans-serif with refined spacing rather than aggressive compression
typography.body: Highly readable medium-size sans for finance explanations
typography.accent: Dense but legible numeric labels, small uppercase metadata, and compact chart captions
typography.treatment: Use sober financial wording and calm section hierarchy; violet highlights direct attention to data and primary actions.

principles: Bright product-led hero
Dashboard UI floating beside or below marketing copy
Rounded low-contrast feature panels
Finance metrics and small charts as supporting proof
Social proof strip
Feature-to-dashboard demonstrations
Clear pricing and trial CTA
layout.density: Moderate, airy marketing layout with dense data modules only inside product demonstrations.

themes.imagery: Realistic dashboard captures, pale cream interfaces, clean analytics widgets and chart fragments; minimal decorative lifestyle photos.
themes.motion: Gentle dashboard widget float, progressive chart draws, soft panel reveals, and quick straightforward button feedback.
guardrails: Separate marketing claims from actual financial figures.
Ensure numeric and chart text remains readable at mobile sizes.
Avoid excessive purple-on-purple contrast loss.
Use representative or clearly labeled demo data.

themes.name: Punk Utility Brutalism
themes.concept: A high-contrast conversion system that combines punk energy with the clarity of a digital operating platform.

typography.display: Heavy grotesk or condensed sans-serif in oversized uppercase
typography.accent: Small uppercase labels for status, category, and section metadata
typography.treatment: Use tight headline line-height, blunt phrasing, and electric-green emphasis on a few key words.

principles: Conversion-led landing-page sequence
Strong horizontal section rules
Large, high-impact hero
Hard-edged grids and cards
Optional alternation between dark and light sections
Clear repeated calls to action
layout.density: Compact and information-rich, with a clear hierarchy from headline to proof, process, resources, and action.

components: Electric-green CTA buttons with hard offset shadows
themes.imagery: Use sparse, purposeful imagery. Let typography, grids, color blocks, subtle dot textures, and product screenshots carry the visual identity.
themes.motion: Use short, direct transitions such as sharp reveals, small shifts, and button press feedback. Keep motion subordinate to the CTA and content.
guardrails: Keep the main CTA obvious and repeat it at useful decision points.
Use electric green as a signal color rather than a background for every section.
Maintain readable body text and comfortable spacing on mobile.
Keep the layout crisp and functional; avoid adding glitch effects or ornamental chaos.

referenceVariants.distinction: Dark foundation, white cards, and green offset edges.
Alternating dark and light sections with bold bordered cards.
Dark dotted-grid treatment with green rules and compact utility labels.

themes.name: Ember Matrix
themes.concept: A dark technical agency system defined by orange display typography, micro-dot matrices, crisp service framing, and low-key operational confidence.

typography.display: Bold highly legible grotesk with alternating orange and off-white lines
typography.body: Compact neutral sans with generous contrast
typography.accent: Narrow utility labels, availability status pills and concise technical metadata
typography.treatment: Use sequential headline color emphasis to build rhythm; keep body copy plain, confident, and functional.

principles: Subtle black dot-matrix canvas
Centered hero with multicolor text emphasis
Thin-line framed or pill-shaped navigation
Small availability status above main headline
Compact client-logo strip
Structured services and process
Case studies with monochrome previews
layout.density: Compact and structured, with high-impact headline contrast and quieter technical details.

themes.imagery: Sparse imagery: black-on-black textures, low-key interface crops, purposeful automation diagrams and restrained orange glows.
themes.motion: Short text-mask reveals, slow dot field movement, button state changes and subtle section entrances; avoid constant blinking.
guardrails: Do not add green indiscriminately; reserve it for status meaning.
Keep dotted texture behind, never competing with readable text.
Avoid visual overlap with Punk Utility Brutalism by preserving orange-and-charcoal matrix character.
Keep contact paths simple and obvious.

themes.name: The Capital Machine
themes.concept: A monumental industrial engine with exposed gears, interconnected modules and acid-lime capital pathways.

typography.display: Heavy editorial grotesk or condensed sans
typography.treatment: Keep headlines separate from artwork; use acid lime as a deliberate emphasis.

principles: Diagonal industrial centerpiece
Modular workflow grid
Input-output diagrams
Compact technical annotations
layout.density: One dominant visual with restrained supporting content.

themes.imagery: Dense monochrome mechanical structure, gears, steel, exploded modules and sparse lime routing; reference image is industrial sci-fi inspiration, not a literal funding engine.
themes.motion: Brief purposeful reveal or hover; static reduced-motion fallback.
guardrails: Preserve accessible reading order
Do not use decorative imagery as proof of product capability
Use owned or licensed artwork
Avoid generic fintech clichés

themes.name: Celestial Capital
themes.concept: A cinematic investment house at the edge of the atmosphere: institutional credibility expressed through an illuminated orbital horizon, refined editorial typography, and quiet portfolio storytelling.

typography.display: High-contrast editorial serif with elegant proportions; optional italic word or phrase for cinematic emphasis.
typography.body: Quiet contemporary grotesk with high legibility and generous tracking where appropriate.
typography.accent: Small uppercase or widely tracked labels for portfolio sectors, fund details, and navigation.
typography.treatment: Center the short editorial hero; contrast expressive serif display type with compact sans-serif proof and restrained numerical metrics.

principles: Full-bleed dark hero with one luminous orbital arc or atmospheric horizon
Minimal, widely spaced navigation anchored above the visual field
Centered editorial headline and compact dual-CTA cluster
Spacious investment-vertical index with curated imagery
Portfolio/company listings with deliberate editorial rhythm
Quiet metrics band, thesis/values sections, and people-led narrative
Alternation between cinematic scenes and calm structured reading areas
layout.density: Sparse and cinematic at entry; moderately information-rich in portfolio, track record, and team sections.

components: Thin separators and understated hover reveals
themes.imagery: Dark atmospheric horizons, abstract planetary glow, carefully art-directed founder and portfolio photography, architectural detail, and soft spectral gradients. One hero spectacle carries the mood; supporting imagery should feel credible and restrained.
themes.motion: Slow atmospheric light drift, subtle image reveals, smooth editorial section transitions, and restrained hover shifts. The orbital effect must work as a static still for reduced-motion settings.
guardrails: Avoid turning the celestial arc into repeated decorative wallpaper.
Never use decorative light to obscure the headline or calls to action.
Keep real portfolio data, fund information, and performance claims distinguishable from examples.
Do not confuse cinematic pacing with slow loading or hidden navigation.
Maintain readable contrast, predictable navigation, and reduced-motion support.

themes.name: Liquid Amethyst AI
themes.concept: A dark creative workshop animated by one sculptural, liquid-amethyst object; vivid purple materiality and tightly composed utility cards make advanced AI creation feel tangible.

typography.display: Contemporary geometric or neo-grotesk sans with confident, compact headlines.
typography.body: Neutral modern sans-serif designed for dark UI panels.
typography.accent: Bright purple highlight words and small readable process labels.
typography.treatment: Use medium-to-heavy weight rather than extra-condensed aggression; let the sculpture deliver visual drama while text explains the product.

principles: Dark rounded hero stage with a split headline and oversized sculptural 3D form
Purple branded framing surface surrounding darker content panels
Compact social-proof strip directly below hero
Three-step creation process rendered as adjacent dark cards
Feature modules alternating practical explanations and creative outputs
Clear path from brief upload to generation, refinement, and export
Controlled spacing with dense feature details below the hero
layout.density: Moderate: a strong sculptural focal point plus closely grouped process and feature cards.

themes.imagery: Glossy translucent purple rings, molten glass, metallic folds, refracted violet highlights, stylized AI-created outputs, and authentic product preview imagery. Favor a coherent material language over unrelated sci-fi illustrations.
themes.motion: Slow object rotation or light sweep, tactile card elevation, and short generation-state transitions. Use a static optimized render on small screens or with reduced motion.
guardrails: Maintain a real product explanation rather than relying on the 3D sculpture alone.
Never let glossy effects impair download, upload, or form usability.
Keep purple accent text short enough to retain contrast.
Avoid large 3D assets that slow mobile loading.
Do not reuse the sculptural hero in every section; reserve it as the focal signature.

themes.name: Lime Precision Fintech
themes.concept: A precision-built financial command surface: an almost-black conversion hero punctuated by signal lime gives way to bright, rounded dashboards that make financial control feel immediate and trustworthy.

typography.display: Clean, confident contemporary sans-serif with large but not distorted proportions.
typography.body: Highly legible neo-grotesk sans with tabular numerals for balances and charts.
typography.accent: Small uppercase product labels, financial metric captions, and concise status tags.
typography.treatment: Use an economical centered hero hierarchy; let crisp currency figures, UI labels, and card balances provide the second typographic layer.

principles: Near-black hero with one lime primary CTA and restrained halo glow
Large realistic dashboard preview overlapping or immediately following hero
Bright interior product UI contrasted against dark marketing frame
Three-step account-to-insight-to-goal explanation
Organized bento-like product feature cards for balance, spending, and goals
Clear pricing or waitlist path and contextual conversion points
Dense financial information contained within calm, rounded panels
layout.density: Low at the top for trust and immediate understanding; moderate inside product demonstrations and metric cards.

components: Account balance and payment card mockups
themes.imagery: Use authentic product UI, balance cards, clean charts, card controls, and mobile-device mockups rather than stock photos or abstract financial symbols. White panels should look like a plausible working application.
themes.motion: Smooth dashboard entrance, short number updates, gentle chart reveals, and subtle lime-button glow. Motion should indicate state changes without mimicking fake financial activity.
guardrails: Keep the visual language polished and rounded; do not import harsh neo-brutalist offsets or distressed type.
Use lime sparingly as an action and highlight color, not across every data tile.
Never present sample balances or results as verified customer outcomes.
Do not use color alone to express financial status.
Keep tables, charts, and forms keyboard accessible and legible on mobile.

themes.name: Violet Event Horizon
themes.concept: A minimal black stage illuminated by a single spectral violet phenomenon; the dramatic glow establishes futuristic agency authority while restrained project and workflow modules prove capability.

typography.display: Large, bold neo-grotesk sans-serif with precise line breaks and very limited decoration.
typography.body: Compact neutral sans-serif with strong light-on-dark contrast.
typography.accent: Small badge labels, service tags, and unobtrusive trust metadata.
typography.treatment: Keep white headlines optically centered over the glow; reserve violet for short badges, CTAs, selected terms, and environmental illumination.

principles: Full-screen or tall dark hero organized around a single violet halo, ring, or horizon glow
Centered bold headline with compact service proposition and dual CTAs
Minimal navigation, spaced proof row, and generous dark negative space
Transition from atmospheric hero into practical services and portfolio sections
Optional starfield or sparse particulate detail only around the hero
Project showcases in editorial rows instead of one endless uniform card grid
Supporting process, pricing, and contact sections retain clean functional geometry
layout.density: Cinematic and sparse above the fold; organized and information-rich in case studies, services, and conversion sections.

components: Minimal navigation with violet contact action
Quiet dark pricing and FAQ modules
themes.imagery: Violet volumetric glow, partial light rings, horizon flares, controlled star particles, and high-quality case study imagery. Xtract favors a suspended nebula ring; Nubien favors a wide rising ultraviolet horizon.
themes.motion: Very slow halo breathing or light drift, subtle parallax, minimal project-image reveals, and fast clear interaction feedback. Never flash, jitter, or animate critical headings.
guardrails: Do not confuse this with Neon Trickster: avoid cyberpunk magenta/cyan overload, glitch typography, and holographic UI noise.
Use one primary atmospheric glow per view rather than multiple competing effects.
Ensure project proof and services are real and easy to find below the spectacle.
Keep primary CTAs high-contrast without relying on glow for legibility.
Provide static alternatives and reduced-motion support.

referenceVariants.distinction: Dark AI automation agency hero with a floating violet ring, subtle star-like particles, and practical task/workflow cards.
Minimal premium AI studio hero with a wide rising ultraviolet horizon, restrained white typography, and curated portfolio sections.

themes.name: Cobalt Velocity Agency
themes.concept: A high-performance digital studio presented through deep-cobalt light, dimensional device compositions, and confident project-first storytelling.

typography.display: Bold modern grotesk with controlled compression and strong mixed-case headlines
typography.body: Clear contemporary sans-serif with relaxed leading
typography.accent: Compact pill labels and small bold call-to-action text
typography.treatment: Keep the hero concise and highly legible; pair large typography with electric-blue light and dimensional visual proof.

principles: Cinematic dark hero with luminous blue focal artwork
Device or website showcase as centerpiece
Project-first storytelling sections
Layered full-bleed panels
Crisp navigation and high-visibility contact actions
Alternating image-heavy and text-rich case study sections
layout.density: Spacious hero and rich project galleries, with tighter service and process sections.

themes.imagery: Real portfolio work presented in layered device frames, reflective deep-blue surfaces, restrained light streaks, and art-directed campaign imagery.
themes.motion: Smooth device entrances, layered depth movement, hover-responsive project previews, and blue-light reveals; avoid heavy continuous animation.
guardrails: Ensure the portfolio demonstrates real work rather than decorative device mockups only.
Keep bright cobalt reserved for priority actions and visual anchors.
Do not let reflections or hero effects obscure copy.
Provide accessible reduced-motion alternatives.
